tools.name: audit_stage2_candidate_coverage
tools.description: Independently re-check every still-unresolved retrieved Knowledge Graph or supplemental candidate after the initial Stage-2 compilation. The audit exposes normative predicates and general verification questions; it contains no benchmark answer IDs, expected wording, or target count.

tools.name: complete_region_batch
tools.description: Record screening status for one to twelve manual regions before requirement registration is sealed.

tools.name: exclude_discovery_candidate_batch
tools.description: Explicitly disposition retrieved candidates that were placed in a domain discovery ledger but are not activated final requirements.

tools.name: seal_requirement_registration
tools.description: Freeze the registered requirement set and begin data-availability assessment.

tools.name: submit_inspection_check_batch
tools.description: Register complete, source-grounded field inspection checks. Keep separately violable predicates separate even when they use the same observation or tool; combine only inseparable branches of one predicate.

tools.name: submit_stage2_candidate_decision_batch
tools.description: Submit one structured applicability-and-atomicity decision for each candidate returned by the Stage-2 coverage audit. The program binds canonical predicate text and provenance and directly registers retained candidates.
